description.narrative:
The project will implement low-cost biodigesters in selected public schools to provide clean, renewable energy while improving sanitation and environmental management. Led entirely by young people, the project will train youth to design, construct, operate, and maintain biodigesters that convert organic waste into bio gas for cooking and organic fertilizer for school gardens. By reducing reliance on firewood, the project will lower deforestation and carbon emissions, improve learning environments, and promote climate-smart agriculture. At the same time, it will build practical green skills, leadership, and employment pathways for youth, while supporting schools and communities to adopt sustainable, locally managed energy solutions.
Goal: Empower youthto lead sustainable energy and climate-smart solutions while improving school environments.
Objectives: 1. Train youth to design, construct, and manage low-costbiodigesters. 2. Provide schools with clean energy and organic fertilizer for gardens. 3. Strengthen youth leadership, technical skills, and green employment opportunities.
Activities: • Conduct youth training on biodigester construction and maintenance. • Buildand commission biodigesters in selected schools. • Facilitate school and community engagement on sustainable energy and agriculture. • Monitor, evaluate, and document youth-led project outcomes.

participating-org.narrative:
Green Nature is a youth-driven, non-profit organisation in Zambia dedicated to conserving the environment for sustainable livelihoods. We work with marginalized communities to combat climate change, protect natural resources, and empower people with knowledge andtools to build resilience.
Our Vision: A future where communities thrive in harmony with nature, strengthened by dynamic climate resilience models and inclusive development.
Our Mission: To restore and preserve nature’s potential, livelihood, and food security for less privileged communities through research, innovation, and technology.
Our Objectives: Climate Action: Combat deforestation,poor farming practices, and unsustainable resource use by promoting conservation and renewable energy. Community Empowerment: Equipvulnerable groups—especially youth and women—with knowledge, skills, and opportunities to lead environmental solutions.
